Scientific Instruments Change - Lake Ontario - Oakville
Subsurface scientific moorings temporarily established 5 metres below the surface at:
43 26.553N 079 39.285W
 43 26.540N 079 39.293W
43 25.719N 079 40.058W
 43 25.706N 079 40.063W
43 25.617N 079 39.617W
 43 25.612N 079 39.647W
43 26.213N 079 38.729W
 43 26.206N 079 38.738W
The moorings have two points; the first being the scientific instrumentation and the second being the end of the poly line.
Mariners are requested to stay clear 100 metres and not set nets or drag the lakebed between the two points.
